title: Kisho Project Metadata
description: Public-safe project metadata registry entry. This schema forbids storing secrets and supports contracts-driven Project Governance metadata.

$schema.description: Optional local schema hint for editors and validators.

project_key.description: Stable project key. Prefer lowercase kebab-case. The file name should be <project_key>.project.json.

product_line.description: Primary product line or governance category.

lifecycle_status.description: Project lifecycle status. This is governance metadata, not a deployment guarantee.

governance_status.description: Governance health label for dashboard display.

github_repo_url.description: GitHub repository URL only. Must not include token, password, or embedded credentials.

migration_path.description: Repo-relative migration path if applicable. This field does not authorize migrations.

supabase_project_alias.description: Human-readable alias only. Never store Supabase keys, JWTs, passwords, project secrets, or connection strings.

railway_service_alias.description: Human-readable alias only. Never store Railway tokens, deploy hooks, or secret environment values.

environments.description: Public-safe environment metadata. Alias fields are display labels only.

owner.description: Owning person, role, or team. Use a role label if personal ownership is not public-safe.

maintainers.description: Public-safe maintainer names, handles, or role labels.

last_verified_at.description: ISO 8601 date or timestamp when the metadata was last reviewed.

notes.description: Non-secret human notes. Do not include credentials, copied env values, or private operational details.

prohibited_secret_fields.description: Explicit reminder of field names and value types that must never be stored in this registry.

frontend_url.description: Public or internal non-secret URL only. Do not store signed URLs or embedded credentials.

backend_url.description: Public or internal non-secret URL only. Do not store signed URLs or embedded credentials.

supabase_alias.description: Alias only. Never store keys, JWTs, passwords, or connection strings.

railway_alias.description: Alias only. Never store tokens, deploy hooks, or secret environment values.
